items.name: c03
items.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 video, exactly 8 seconds, one continuous shot, no cuts. Handcrafted tabletop miniature diorama photography, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, warm soft practical light. The attached image is the FIRST FRAME: keep every object's shape, size, colour and position consistent with it. The main creature (whenever visible) keeps its exact anatomy and size.
The Lithodid king crab features a robust, crab-like armored carapace that is either densely covered in long, sharp spines or heavily textured with coarse nodules. Coloration ranges from deep solid red to bright orange, sometimes mottled with white or purple spots. It has four visible pairs of appendages: one pair of front arms ending in claws (often asymmetrical), and three pairs of long, spiny walking legs. A fifth pair of legs is hidden inside the gill chamber. Small, black, stalked eyes are positioned close together at the front. The underside has a short, folded abdomen made of plates.

TIMELINE
0.0-1.8s: The camera looks down at a slightly high angle onto a wooden worktable featuring a green cutting mat with grid lines but no text or numbers. A handcrafted clay king crab figurine, deep red with white spots, rests flipped on its back, held in place by oversized metal tweezers attached to a wire clamp. A real cotton swab lies nearby. The tilt-shift focus emphasizes the miniature scale. The camera slowly pushes in slightly. 1.8-3.0s: The camera remains steady. The crab's folded abdomen plates made of clay are clearly visible on its underside. 3.0-8.0s: From beneath the folded abdomen plates, a tiny, hidden fifth pair of clay legs emerges and begins actively sweeping and cleaning the gill area. The tweezers and cotton swab remain motionless under the warm desk lamp lighting.
SOUND: none needed (it will be replaced). No music. No dialogue.
NEVER SHOW: text, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, watermarks; real human hands, fingers or people; extra or different creatures; the main creature growing, shrinking or changing shape; morphing or melting objects; cuts, jump cuts or flicker.
